items.title: New ResokerRAT Uses Telegram Bot API to Control Infected Windows Systems
items.description: A new Remote Access Trojan (RAT) called ResokerRAT has been found targeting Windows systems by abusing Telegram’s widely used Bot API to receive commands and send stolen data back to attackers. items.title: METATRON – Open-Source AI Penetration Testing Assistant Brings Local LLM Analysis to Linux
items.description: A new open-source penetration testing framework called METATRON is gaining attention in the security research community for its fully offline, AI-driven approach to vulnerability assessment. items.title: 36 Malicious npm Strapi Packages Used to Deploy Redis RCE and Persistent C2 Malware
